title: [Main] [ALL-E] "Item tracking is defined for item 1000 in the Requisition Line. You must delete the existing item tracking before modifying or deleting the Requisition line" err when creating a Purchase Order from a Sales Order including DROP Shipment Bug 643358
summary: Fixes an error that occurred when creating a purchase order from a sales order with drop shipment, where item tracking validation was preventing requisition line operations.
key_points: Resolves incorrect item tracking validation error when processing drop shipments
Corrects logic in Order Planning Management to handle requisition lines properly
Updates related sales line planning code to prevent unwanted item tracking checks
Includes test coverage for the drop shipment scenario
